name: Bézier-boundary gradient approximation
definition: A strategy to approximate the gradients of a discontinuous indicator function g(·) with respect to control point coordinates, enabling backpropagation in Gaussian Splatting despite g(·) being piecewise constant and non-differentiable.
summary: Bézier-boundary gradient approximation enables backpropagation for discontinuous indicator functions in Gaussian Splatting by approximating gradients with respect to Bézier control points, unlike standard methods that lack native support for such non-differentiable functions.
